description: Check one web page for AEO, SEO and performance: can a machine consume it? Returns the findings by check and the report link. If the exact page was scanned in the last 24 hours the stored result is returned at no cost; set fresh to scan again. A page that blocks our scanner is returned as blocked with no score, because it cannot pass. Free, no account needed.

fresh.description: Set true to always run a new scan instead of returning a stored result under 24 hours old. A new scan uses the stricter new-scan rate limit.

url.description: The page to check, such as https://example.com/pricing. A bare domain works.

name: scan_page
title: Scan a page
